pages.title: Preserved Foods
pages.text: SteamCraft adds two special foods that last much longer than ordinary food. $(bold)Beef Jerky$() and the $(bold)MRE$() are both great for long adventures where you cannot keep a fridge nearby.

pages.title: Beef Jerky
pages.text: Beef Jerky restores $(bold)4 hunger$() and has a good shelf life. It is made by cooking Cooked Beef a second time in a furnace — the extra heat removes all the moisture, so it keeps much longer.
Smelt Cooked Beef to dry it into Beef Jerky.

pages.title: MRE
pages.text: The MRE (Meal Ready to Eat) is a high-calorie pack that restores $(bold)10 hunger$() and $(bold)2.0 saturation$(). It is very filling and lasts a long time. Great for dangerous expeditions into the Nether or deep caves.
Combine preserved foods and materials to craft an MRE.
